title: Search the archive
lead: One query searches documents, fonds, collections, exhibitions, news and site pages at once — by words and by meaning.
label: Search query
placeholder: For example: photographs of Ust-Kamenogorsk in the 1960s

start.title: What you can search for
start.text: Enter an organisation's name, a surname, an event, a year or a document reference code. Typos and word forms are taken into account.

catalog.label: Document catalogue with filters
catalog.text: Narrow down by document type, period, fonds, dates and topic.

funds.label: List of fonds
funds.text: Find a fonds by an organisation's current or former name.

assistant.label: Archive assistant
assistant.text: Ask in your own words — the assistant suggests where to look and explains how to get a certificate.

noVector: Semantic search is unavailable right now; showing keyword matches.

ai.title: Assistant's answer
ai.label: This text is generated automatically and is not an archival certificate.
ai.busy: The assistant is preparing an answer…
ai.suggest: Narrow the results using conditions from your query
ai.openInCatalog: Open the catalogue with these conditions
ai.notFound: The assistant found no materials to base an answer on. This does not affect the search results.
ai.offTopic: The assistant only answers questions about the archive, its fonds and services. The search by your words ran as usual.
ai.unavailable: The assistant is unavailable right now. Search works without it.
ai.rateLimited: The assistant has received too many questions. Try again in {seconds} s. Search works without it.
ai.rateLimitedNoTime: The assistant has received too many questions. Try again a little later. Search works without it.
